headline: On October 9, 1986: Fox Broadcasting Company Launches
captionCards: Competed with ABC, CBS, and NBC
instagramCaption:
News Corporation launched the Fox Broadcasting Company on October 9, 1986. This new network entered the US television market as a direct competitor to the established Big Three networks: ABC, CBS, and NBC. It served as the flagship property for what would become Fox Corporation.

Today, Fox remains a major commercial broadcast entity through Fox Entertainment. Its launch fundamentally shifted the competitive landscape of American television broadcasting.
